title: Print Work Order prints the chip next to the no-charge line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, line 2 marked No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The print shows "No Charge · Goodwill" next to line 2; line 1 prints with no chip.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E8: “Mark as No Charge is not offered on a declined line, on a line that already has a return or a credit, or on a line of a work order that is internal or No Charge as a whole. The Board card and any list reading the stored total show the billable total of the work order; Print Work Order prints the "No Charge · [category]" chip next to the line. An asset carrying an Internal category that moves to a customer without the flag keeps the stored value, hidden until the customer is flagged. Reopen then Close on a work order whose category was archived in between keeps the archived category and its account. The customer page Fees & Discounts tab keeps the history of removed adjustments as it does for deleted ones today.”
  • S2-R22: “The per-line warranty flag that exists in the data and in the Open API (is_warranty; there is no toggle in the line dialog today and Print Work Order never printed it) becomes derived: true on a line that is No Charge with the category Warranty and on every line of a whole Warranty work order, false otherwise, never set by hand. Print Work Order gains the "No Charge · [category]" chip next to a no-charge line (S12-E8). Existing lines that carry the flag keep it as it is; they are not priced, marked or changed by the release.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
